title: Hanako ve Balinanın Şarkısı
author: Akasya Asıltürkmen
description: Hanako and the Whale’s Song is the second adventure of a courageous little nature lover who can talk to all the creatures in the world. Hanako wants to help Riyuchi, a giant whale who has washed ashore, but he is so huge that carrying him back to the sea seems almost impossible. Hanako needs people’s help, while Riyuchi needs to send his voice to his distant family. The story teaches the value of loving nature, the bond between living creatures, and the importance of helping one another.
